description: This file defines the interface, constants, structures, enumerations, and class declarations related to network management within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes definitions for network events, IP settings, interface states, and a Network class that manages network operations such as retrieving interface configurations, setting IP settings, and handling interface status changes.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A plugin class managing network interfaces, IP configurations, and connectivity status within WPEFramework. It implements JSONRPC and IInternet interfaces for remote procedure calls and internet status reporting.
